# FrostyFlow

Visual AI Workflow Automation + Blockchain
Build, deploy, and automate AI workflows with on-chain subscriptions

🚀 Launch App • Features • Pricing • Tech Stack • Report Issues

--- ## About FrostyFlow is a visual workflow automation platform for AI agents and blockchain integrations, built by [FrostyLabs](https://frostylabs.ai). Create complex AI workflows with a drag-and-drop interface, connect to MCP servers, and deploy automated workflows to run on schedules or webhooks. > **Note:** The FrostyFlow UI and Engine are currently private repositories. This public repo is for issue tracking and community feedback. --- ## Features - 🤖 **AI Chat Interface** - Chat with multiple AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, and more) - 🔀 **Visual Workflow Builder** - Drag-and-drop workflow editor with 50+ node types - 🔌 **MCP Integration** - Connect to Model Context Protocol servers for extended capabilities - ⏰ **Scheduled Workflows** - Run workflows on cron schedules - 🔗 **Webhook Triggers** - Trigger workflows via HTTP webhooks - 💼 **Thirdweb Vault** - Secure wallet management for on-chain actions - 🔐 **NFT-Based Subscriptions** - On-chain subscription management on Base --- ## Subscription Tiers FrostyFlow uses **NFT-based subscriptions** on the **Base** blockchain. Your subscription status is determined by NFT ownership in your connected wallet - no databases, just on-chain truth. | Feature | Free | Pro | Enterprise | |---------|------|-----|------------| | Workflows | 5 | 50 | Unlimited | | API Calls/Month | 50 | 500 | 2,000 | | Premium AI Models | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | MCP Servers | Basic | Advanced | All | | Workflow Scheduling | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | | Priority Support | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ### NFT Subscription Contracts (Base Mainnet) | Tier | Contract Address | BaseScan | |------|------------------|----------| | **Pro** | `0x4667CE0c2ff16454d860b189b7764CF6a9ED1D7e` | [View on BaseScan](https://basescan.org/address/0x4667CE0c2ff16454d860b189b7764CF6a9ED1D7e) | | **Enterprise** | `0xd691b48C835fA577b4BeD3A3d7EdbEFD4C231ED3` | [View on BaseScan](https://basescan.org/address/0xd691b48C835fA577b4BeD3A3d7EdbEFD4C231ED3) | ### How It Works 1. **Connect your wallet** via Thirdweb (supports MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet, Rainbow, and 10+ others) 2. **Purchase a subscription NFT** using USDC on Base 3. **Your tier is verified on-chain** - no account linking required 4. **Subscriptions auto-expire** after 30 days (renewable when 90%+ expired) The contracts are built using [Unlock Protocol V15](https://unlock-protocol.com/), providing time-based NFT memberships with automatic expiration. --- ## Tech Stack ### Frontend (FrostyFlow) - **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router) - **React:** React 19 - **Styling:** Tailwind CSS 4 - **UI Components:** Radix UI, shadcn/ui - **State:** React Query (TanStack Query) - **Workflow Editor:** React Flow ### Backend - **Runtime:** Node.js 22 - **Database:** PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM - **AI SDK:** Vercel AI SDK - **Authentication:** Thirdweb Auth (wallet-based) ### Blockchain - **Chain:** Base (Chain ID: 8453) - **Wallet Infrastructure:** [Thirdweb](https://thirdweb.com) - Connect Button & Wallet SDK - In-App Wallets (social login) - Vault (secure key management) - **Subscription Contracts:** Unlock Protocol V15 ### AI Providers - OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-4o, o1, o3) - Anthropic (Claude 3.5, Claude 4) - Google (Gemini 2.0, 2.5) - xAI (Grok) - Groq (Llama, Mixtral) - OpenRouter (100+ models) ### Infrastructure - **Hosting:** Self-hosted on Coolify - **Package Manager:** pnpm --- ## Reporting Issues Found a bug or have a feature request? Please open an issue! ### Before Opening an Issue 1. **Search existing issues** to avoid duplicates 2. **Check the app status** at [flow.frostylabs.ai](https://flow.frostylabs.ai) 3. **Gather relevant info:** - Browser and version - Wallet provider (if applicable) - Steps to reproduce - Screenshots or error messages ### Issue Templates - 🐛 **Bug Report** - Something isn't working correctly - ✨ **Feature Request** - Suggest a new feature or improvement - 💬 **General Question** - Ask about usage or capabilities [➡️ Open an Issue](https://github.com/FrostyLabsAi/frostyflow/issues/new) --- ## Links - 🌐 **Website:** [frostylabs.ai](https://frostylabs.ai) - 🚀 **App:** [flow.frostylabs.ai](https://flow.frostylabs.ai) - 🐦 **Twitter/X:** [@FrostyLabsAi](https://x.com/FrostyLabsAi) --- ## License FrostyFlow is proprietary software. This repository is for issue tracking only. © 2025 FrostyLabs. All rights reserved.
